sections.overview: A microscopic marine parasite in the group Orthonectida.
sections.identification: Its body narrows between epidermal rings 9 and 10.
sections.habitat: It was found in Mytilus trossulus in Puget Sound.
sections.diet: Its diet has not been described in detail.
sections.behavior: Behavior outside its host is not documented.
sections.reproduction: The original study recorded reproductive cells.
sections.ecology: Its congener S. burresoni parasitizes an ascidian and differs in body length and reproductive traits.

sources.title: Kozloff 1993 — Three new species of Stoecharthrum
